annotations.title: Check a 'new bank details' email before changing a supplier's account (paid)

description: Use when a supplier (or someone posing as one) asks to change bank details or pay to a new account, the biggest single loss in accounts payable. Send text (the whole email with its From: line), or sender and iban; add website (the supplier's real domain), known_iban (the account you pay now) and name plus country to also run the supplier invoice check. The text is not stored. Input: text, or sender + iban; website, known_iban, name, country. Costs 0.06 USDC via x402, or 30 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

name.description: Supplier name: also runs the invoice check

text.description: The whole email, with its From: line
